note: Reference copy of the _result.json contract, for reading only; no code loads this file. The enforced copy lives in scripts/run_extractor.py (RESULT_REQUIRED_KEYS / STRUCTURE_REQUIRED_KEYS, checked by _validate_result before writing _result.json).
filled_by: every key is auto-produced by the extractor's extract() return; the runner validates and writes _result.json but injects nothing, and no key is hand-filled. Human-maintained extractor inputs live in extractors/<name>/password.json (candidates) and extractors/<name>/config.json (scraping policy), not in this contract.

source_legend.input file: derived from the incoming path itself, before any archive parsing
source_legend.full listing: derived from the complete archive listing (after entry_limit truncation)
source_legend.extraction outcome: derived from what sampling/polling actually did

entry_id.source: auto (input file) — sha256[:8] of the incoming file

kind.source: auto (input file) — archive if the extension is .zip/.7z, else file

sha256.source: auto (input file) — full hash of the incoming file

structure.source: auto (full listing) — shape in STRUCTURE_REQUIRED_KEYS below

password_found.source: auto (extraction outcome) — password polling hit a candidate from password.json

warnings.source: auto (extraction outcome) — runtime log: skips, truncations, fallbacks

files_kept.source: auto (extraction outcome) — files written to the out dir (sampled count; 1 for a plain file)

entry_count.source: auto (full listing) — all entries incl. sampled-out ones

total_uncompressed.source: auto (full listing) — sum of member sizes

top_level_dirs.source: auto (full listing) — first path segments, top 50

multi_part.source: auto (input file) — SPLIT_VOLUME_RE on the input file name
